paper: Adaptive enhancement of learning protocol in hippocampal cultured networks grown on multielectrode arrays
method: Closed-loop stimulation with adaptive activity-dependent reinforcement condition using response-to-stimulus ratio (R/S) threshold
key_metrics: Learning effect preserved after 4-6 hours; enhanced number of highly respondent electrodes (>50%); successful learning in ~50% of trials
limitation: Focused on hippocampal cultures only; required specific threshold estimation parameter (R/SThr% = 15%)
gap: Limited to single electrode training; no spatial patterning across electrode arrays

paper: Learning to control the brain through adaptive closed-loop patterned stimulation
method: Model-free adaptive closed-loop stimulation (ACLS) system combining multi-electrode recordings with multi-site stimulation
key_metrics: Learned specific neural activity patterns in ~15 minutes; 85.42% success rate in vivo; robust to noise and drift
limitation: Tested primarily in mouse visual cortex; limited to 5-15 multiunit neurons
gap: Lack of standardized encoding strategies for complex sensory-motor tasks

paper: Evaluating Encoding Strategies for Closed-Loop Classification in Biological Neural Networks
method: Compared rate-based, phase-based, burst-based, and time-to-first-spike temporal encodings using Cortical Labs CL-1 platform
key_metrics: Burst-based temporal encoding achieved up to 95.6% accuracy in binary classification; optimized configuration used 16 encoding electrodes and 4+4 feedback electrodes
limitation: Performance dropped to 50.6% for 4-class tasks; scalability limitations identified
gap: Need for joint optimization of temporal and spatial encoding strategies for complex tasks

method: Open-source NeuroRighter system for multi-electrode recording and simultaneous patterned microstimulation
key_metrics: Capable of suppressing epileptiform activity; electrically training cultures on navigation tasks; minimal stimulation artifact
limitation: Requires significant technical expertise; primarily demonstrated in rodent models
gap: Limited accessibility for broad neuroscience community due to custom hardware/software requirements

paper: Online supervised learning of temporal patterns in biological neural networks under feedback control
method: Real-time closed-loop BNN system integrating cultured cortical neurons with microfluidic devices and HD-MEAs for FORCE learning
key_metrics: System learned to generate periodic and chaotic temporal signals; sustained oscillations at distinct frequencies (4-30s)
limitation: Complex setup requiring microfluidic integration; limited demonstration of complex pattern generation
gap: Need for simplified closed-loop interfaces for diverse temporal pattern generation tasks

paper: Regulation of Synaptic Plasticity and Adaptive Convergence Under Rhythmic Stimulation of an In Vitro Hippocampal Neuronal Network
method: Rhythmic electrical stimulation at 7.8 Hz (Schumann Resonance) and 40 Hz (gamma frequency) with varying pulse repetitions
key_metrics: Demonstrated frequency-specific adaptive regulatory properties; quantified dynamic evolution of network plasticity
limitation: Focused on hippocampal networks; limited exploration of learning rules beyond plasticity modulation
gap: Lack of closed-loop adaptive stimulation protocols for organizing network dynamics toward computational goals

method: Closed-loop electrophysiology framework embedding mouse cortical organoids into pole-balancing task (cartpole) with adaptive training signals
key_metrics: Adaptive training with reinforcement learning improved performance from 10s to >60s balanced control; proficiency >45% with continuous adaptive training
limitation: Improvements did not persist after 45-min rest period; required intact glutamatergic transmission
gap: Need for mechanisms to consolidate short-term plasticity into longer-term memory traces

paper: Long-Term Potentiation and Closed-Loop Learning in Paired Brain Organoids for CNS Drug Discovery
method: Embedded electrode array (EEA) platform supporting electrophysiological integration of paired CNS-3D human brain organoids with closed-loop maze-game paradigm
key_metrics: Demonstrated robust, pharmacologically tunable STP and LTP; closed-loop learning elicited adaptive behavioral responses dependent on exogenous BDNF
limitation: Relies on pharmacological modulation for LTP; complexity of paired organoid system may limit throughput
gap: Need for fully synthetic closed-loop learning systems without external pharmacological dependencies

paper: In vitro neurons learn and exhibit sentience when embodied in a simulated game-world (DishBrain)
method: DishBrain system integrating in vitro neural networks with in silico computing via high-density MEA for real-time closed-loop interaction in simulated Pong environment
key_metrics: Apparent learning within 5 minutes of real-time gameplay; significantly increased rally lengths over time; species-dependent learning capabilities
limitation: Complex closed-loop environment requiring specialized hardware/software integration; limited to simple game-worlds
gap: Need for standardized closed-loop interfaces to enable reproducible complex task embodiment across labs

paper: Biological Neurons Compete with Deep Reinforcement Learning in Sample Efficiency in a Simulated Gameworld
method: Compared learning efficiency of in vitro biological neural networks (DishBrain) to state-of-the-art deep RL algorithms (DQN, A2C, PPO) in simplified Pong simulation
key_metrics: Biological cultures outperformed deep RL algorithms across game performance characteristics with limited samples; higher sample efficiency demonstrated
limitation: Comparison limited to simplified Pong environment; biological system requires specialized maintenance
gap: Need to understand mechanisms behind biological sample efficiency for hybrid bio-silicon learning systems
